title: Moral Support and Performance
eligible_reason: Single adoption date: the Argentinean ban on visiting supporters (law) applies to all first-division league games from August 2013. Regressions (Tables 2-6) are match-level OLS/logit of visitor_loser on law with club or match-pair FE and robust/clustered SEs; cup games (Table 4) serve as a placebo sample. No unit-specific adoption timing.
design_notes: Package replication_package_MS-BDE-21-02906: ReadME.md, do/00_run_all.do, Table_1-6.do, Figure_1-4.do, dta/data_1_liga.dta (league matches), data_2_copa.dta (cup), data_3_lineups.dta, data_4_squad_values.dta, data_5_lineup_values.dta, Variable_labels.xlsx, tex/ for assembling output.
screener_notes: Goodman-Bacon cited but not applicable (single date).
